lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity local maxima arranged in approximately four visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. Blobs exhibit roughly equidistant spacing along the vertical axes, with the largest diameters concentrated in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid-like arrangement across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient consisting of high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two commensal fish (Echeneidae) positioned near the pectoral fin: one dorsal to the fin base and one ventral to the distal tip.
